topic: What if light kept getting slower every hour?

script.text: You wave at your best friend across the street. He doesn't wave back. You wave again. Fifteen seconds later, he finally waves. Not because he's slow. Because the light from your hand took fifteen seconds to reach him.
You switch on a flashlight and start running. And you win. You beat the beam to the end of the street.
You look up at the sky. It's noon. There are no clouds. And the Sun is going out. Not exploding. Not moving. Its light just can't get here anymore.
What if light kept getting slower, every hour?
At first, nobody even notices. Then it's the best day off school ever. And by tomorrow night, the only thing that matters is getting underground.
